notes.f1: ps_001 (not_proved) engages the 14 Dec 1919 entry (6YP6-D37M, 6B9P) but 'conclusively' rules it out on reading the mother as 'Barria' rather than Corrêa, and never names the elder brother baptised 1839 as a candidate. It also makes the 1851 subject 'husband of Ana Augusta de Jesus', the 1865 groom, conflating the two brothers. The not_proved tier is not over-stated; the elimination and the identity are.
